title: Exact rare-arm Chernoff envelopes for heterogeneous Bernoulli treatment effects
limitations: Potential outcomes must satisfy known deterministic bounds.
The exact statement concerns the least-favorable Laplace transform; Chernoff inversion need not equal the exact least-favorable tail probability.
No claim of uniform dominance over variance-adaptive or dependent-design intervals.

artifacts.purpose: Deterministic checks of the rare-arm MGF orientation and the numerical confidence-width comparison.
